emptyCurrent: No project time this week yet. Recording starts with “Start”.
noEmployee: Project time is only available for accounts with a personnel number. HR can link this account to an employee record.

firstRun.title: No clients and projects yet
firstRun.text: Project time is always booked on a project, and every project belongs to a client. Once both exist, the timer can start.

noProjects.title: No project released yet
noProjects.text: HR sets up clients and projects. As soon as a project is bookable for this account, it shows up here.

timer.label: Project timer
timer.longText: The timer has been running since {{since}}, more than 12 hours. After stopping, the actual end can be entered.
timer.changed: The timer was stopped or started elsewhere in the meantime. The display is up to date again.

chip.label: Running timer
chip.long: The timer has been running for more than 12 hours

fix.title: Correct the end
fix.text: The timer ran since {{since}} and is stopped now. When did the work actually end?

detail.rawHint: Sum of the entries. Rounding applies per project, task and day.

lock.draft: On a draft invoice and locked until the draft releases the time again.

entry.title: Manual entry
entry.noteHint: Required for a manual entry: what was done? The note stays in the audit log.
entry.noteHintEdit: Optional. The change stays in the audit log.
entry.invoiced: The entry is on an invoice or a draft invoice and is locked.
entry.voidText: {{span}}, {{project}}. The entry no longer counts but stays in the audit log.

hint.PROJECT_OVER_WORKED: More project time than clocked working time
hint.PROJECT_OUTSIDE_WORK: Project time outside the clocked working time

coverage.legend: Reconciliation with the clock, as a hint only: no finding under the Arbeitszeitgesetz (Working Hours Act) and not part of the month-end close. Differences up to 5 minutes do not count.

unbilled.title: Unbilled
unbilled.hint: Billable time up to today, rounded, amounts net. The client name opens a new invoice.

team.title: Team project time
team.empty: Nobody in this team has project time this week.
team.legend: Minutes without amounts. The name opens the person's week with its breakdown.

rounding.up: Rounding increment {{increment}} min, rounded up: {{raw}} becomes {{rounded}}
rounding.nearest: Rounding increment {{increment}} min, rounded to nearest: {{raw}} becomes {{rounded}}
rounding.down: Rounding increment {{increment}} min, rounded down: {{raw}} becomes {{rounded}}

rate.task_employee: Rate of the task for this person, valid from {{validFrom}}
rate.task: Rate of the task, valid from {{validFrom}}
rate.project_employee: Rate of the project for this person, valid from {{validFrom}}
rate.project: Rate of the project, valid from {{validFrom}}
rate.client_employee: Rate of the client for this person, valid from {{validFrom}}
rate.client: Rate of the client, valid from {{validFrom}}
